BiblicalUsage: Meshiccah is plunder, spoil, the prey taken from a conquered people. 2 Kings 21:14 says God will deliver the remnant into the hand of their enemies, and they shall become a prey and a spoil, and Habakkuk 2:7 warns the plunderer that those he bit shall rise up and he shall be for booties unto them.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe plunder turns on the plunderer: the spoil God gives to judgment becomes the spoil of the next judgment.
